title: Galle: A Heritage city under threat
scope: UNESCO-era gentrification and living heritage
limitations: interview based on doctoral research; use thesis for exact measures

title: Towards a Virtual Slave Island
scope: colonial genealogy, contemporary redevelopment and displacement
limitations: project description; distinguish aims from completed findings

title: Invented Heritage: The Last Sri Lankan King’s Prison Cell in Colombo
scope: postcolonial memory construction and archival correction
limitations: motive for 1950s monument remains interpretive

title: To Give or Not to Give it Back to Sri Lanka
scope: restitution/provenance diplomacy
limitations: event programme, not evidence for each argument

title: Perspectives on Post-War Sri Lanka
scope: routes to scholarship on rebel governance, gendered violence, reconciliation and authoritarianism
limitations: speaker list/navigation only

title: American Board letters from Jaffna, 1816–1817
scope: missionaries’ own choice of Jaffna and Brownrigg permission for residence, school and printing press
limitations: missionary self-report; transcription incomplete in places; use for administrative sequence, not motives of all actors

title: Ceylon mission correspondence on foreign missionaries, 1820
scope: later lieutenant-governor resistance to admitting additional foreign missionaries
limitations: specific administrative dispute; cannot be back-projected wholesale onto Brownrigg’s 1816 policy

title: A Nation of Ink and Paint: Map Drawing and Geographic Pedagogy in the American Ceylon Mission
scope: American Ceylon Mission educational investment, pedagogy and long-term social effects in Jaffna
limitations: education-history lens; not a complete explanation of Tamil political mobilization

title: The Two Societies: a Study of Town Life in Nineteenth-Century Ceylon
scope: comparative nineteenth-century education including earlier stronger female English education in Jaffna
limitations: urban and missionary evidence; avoid treating all northern households as beneficiaries

title: Economic Liberalization versus Political Pluralism in Sri Lanka?
scope: Jaffna specialization in higher education and effect of university standardization/district quotas
limitations: political-economy synthesis; pair with admissions-specific literature

title: Trilingual Blunders: Signboards, Social Media, and Transnational Sri Lankan Tamil Publics
scope: post-1956 language policy and its particular effect on English-educated Jaffna Tamils
limitations: language/public-culture focus; not a complete labour-market history

title: Guardians of the Law — Buddhism and official-language politics
scope: Sinhala-only as postcolonial populist decolonization and linguistic nationalism
limitations: constitutional-law and religion lens; distinguish decolonization motive from distributive ethnic effects

title: Three meanings of colonialism: Nehru, Sukarno, and Kotelawala debate the future of the Third World Movement (1954–61)
scope: Colombo Powers 1954, Bandung 1955, Belgrade 1961 and Ceylon's contested place in early non-alignment
limitations: focuses on elite diplomatic concepts of colonialism rather than domestic political economy

title: Crude Alliance — Economic Decolonisation and Oil Power in the Non-Aligned World
scope: Sirimavo Bandaranaike, 1976 Colombo NAM summit and New International Economic Order ambitions
limitations: 1970s oil/economic-decolonization focus; do not back-project radical NAM economics to Bandung as a settled doctrine

title: Sri Lanka — National Strategies for Regional Integration
scope: 1960s–1970s inward-looking dirigisme, terms-of-trade pressures and 1977 outward-policy reversal
limitations: macro-policy synthesis; does not isolate language policy as a growth determinant

title: The Outlook for Ceylon, NIE 54-58
scope: contemporary US assessment of Bandaranaike neutralism, removal of British base rights and expanded Sino-Soviet relations
limitations: US intelligence perspective with Cold War bias; strong for contemporaneous actions, weak as neutral interpretation

title: Sri Lanka Higher Education: Innovative Learning to Prepare Employment Ready Graduates
scope: English, communication and employability skills as continuing labour-market priorities
limitations: development-programme perspective; cannot establish a counterfactual growth loss caused by 1950s language policy

title: Sri Lanka literacy rates by district, 2012
scope: official district literacy comparison and education tables
limitations: literacy is not equivalent to school quality, examination performance or historical educational advantage

title: University of Jaffna — History
scope: 1974 campus establishment, 1979 autonomy and wartime institutional disruption
limitations: institutional self-history; use official dates, not self-evaluative claims

title: The antiquity of Jaffna Fort: new evidence from post-disaster archaeological investigations in northern Sri Lanka
scope: post-disaster archaeology, tourism/conservation tension and pre-colonial Indian Ocean layers at Jaffna Fort
limitations: project-gallery format; early strata remain partly mixed and some dating provisional

title: Jaffna Fort Post Disaster Archaeological Research Project panel
scope: field interpretation of restoration, visitor development and subsurface heritage risk
limitations: public panel; corroborated by the 2019 Antiquity publication

title: The President — Anura Kumara Dissanayake
scope: current presidency and accession date
limitations: official biographical source; no independent interpretation

title: General Election 2024 Results
scope: 2024 parliamentary composition
limitations: official results, no causal interpretation

title: Sri Lanka Fifth and Sixth Reviews under EFF
scope: 2026 macroeconomic programme status
